title: Qualify the 6.1.2 release candidate on macos-15 after the macos-14 brownout and ship #834 in 6.1.2
description: Qualify the 6.1.2 release candidate on macos-15 after the macos-14 brownout and ship #834 in 6.1.2
no_spec_change_rationale: Release workflow runner image and release notes only; no runtime, canonical API, Action default, risk or provenance policy changes.
acceptance_criteria: The release.yml qualify job's macOS matrix entry runs on macos-15 instead of the retired macos-14 image; its platform name, fledge asset and checksum and every other workflow line are unchanged.

CHANGELOG.md 6.1.2 and docs/releases/6.1.2.md add #834 (#768 case 1: check --fix keeps export rows in the table that already holds documented exports; case 2 stays open), name the new candidate source commit on origin/main, and record that v6.1.2-rc.1 failed qualification because of the scheduled macos-14 brownout and is superseded by v6.1.2-rc.2.
No runtime source, canonical spec, dependency, tag or release changes; v6.1.2-rc.1 is left as is.
